flags.name: repo
flags.description: path to the repository to inspect

flags.name: terms
flags.description: absolute path to the folder holding this project's .inspector.json, Dockerfile.inspector and check script, for a repository none of the three may be committed to; omitted when the repository carries them itself

flags.name: no-stamp
flags.description: takes no value; publish a green result as usual but post no commit status at all, for a repository whose CI must not be touched

flags.name: branch
flags.description: pull request branch to publish after a green result

flags.name: expected-tip
flags.description: commit origin's copy of the branch is expected to be at, so a rewritten branch is published with force-with-lease; omitted when the branch was never published or was not rewritten

flags.name: pr-title
flags.description: pull request title to open after a green result

flags.name: pr-body-file
flags.description: path to a file containing the pull request body

flags.name: vendor
flags.description: the reviewer's vendor, for judging the change's test edits; its key is read from <VENDOR>_API_KEY

flags.name: model
flags.description: the reviewer's model, named by the same vendor
